prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for optimistic craft and travel sequence. Instruments: fingerstyle guitar, mandolin, hand percussion. 114 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and cheerful acoustic folk-pop track featuring bright acoustic guitars, a playful plucked melody, and a steady rhythm section. It evokes a lighthearted and positive atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首欢快活泼的民谣流行乐曲，以明亮的木吉他、俏皮的拨弦旋律和稳定的节奏部分为特色。营造出轻松愉快的积极氛围。
